name: Pasifik Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi AS
summary: Pasifik Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi AS operates as a real estate investment trust. It constructs and invests in hotels, offices, and residential buildings. The company was founded by Fatih Erdogan, Abdulkerim Firat, and Mehmet Erdogan on December 11, 2020 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
